title: recover-P: STNFS core, run gate: expected total work 2^114.320027565561

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, uniform challenges and fresh coins, proof.md's algorithm returns P with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 at expected total work at most 1+(K/2^64)(2^115.6540589+2^66) < 2^114.320027565561 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000); every run below 2^116.825661 units. The coin is part of the one cold attack on the one target: the run reads one fresh 64-bit coin before any other work, then either stops at the charged closed-gate cost (a failure) or, with probability K/2^64, performs the whole attack; K=7317054261581634447 is least with (K/2^64) lo_run >= 0.39. The work is that one run's expected total work over the challenge and all coins; nothing is amortized over other targets or runs. lo_run=0.983214 (opened-run success) and the expected run work 2^115.6540589+2^66 (proof.md section 8) both take twice the modeled expected descent work. Under H1-H5, H5c, H5e, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit: code identity, parameters, probes, both ledgers, opened-run success, gate K and K-1, claim. One key per run: {"descent": "tree"} descent recurrence; {"load": k} child load k; {"ideal": i} PREREG-D type i's worst ideal (0: boot).
